objects.name: Analytic 1658
objects.description: For iOS, detect Unix Shell from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Command Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: Shell or command-executing child process with arguments spawned under managed app context on supervised iOS device]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [Managed iOS app invokes process-launch behavior resulting in sh, bash, or equivalent shell child process on supervised device — any shell spawn on stock iOS is a jailbreak indicator]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
